notes.title: Platformory goes free to play!
notes.notes:
[b]From the 20th of June, Platformory will be available for free![/b]

A huge thanks to everyone that bought and supported the game, this decision was made due to the small amount of sales, which were most likely caused by the high difficulty and the niche nature of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468610/Platformory/

notes.title: Platformory is officially released!
notes.notes:
I hope every single one of you will enjoy your experience with the game!
